invariants: Observed requires actual evidence and coverage; a recorded zero is observed Money with minor_units 0, never unknown.
Estimated requires at least one explicitly bounded amount or remains unknown; lower/upper currencies and exponents match the enclosing Economics currency and each other.
Unknown has no amount field and never becomes zero during totals.
No MoneyKnowledge variant is a Grant, Reservation or spendable ResourceAccount; consequential admission requires the kernel actual bounded authority inputs.
Amounts are nonnegative minutes; observed requires timing evidence and coverage.
Estimated is not verified human availability; unknown cannot be counted as unused capacity.

Economics: observed_revenue and observed_cost allow observed or unknown, never estimated presented as actual.
All observed amounts in a currency report match its currency; retain explicit exponent.
Outstanding cost may be observed, estimated or unknown; actual closure_reserve is observed or unknown. A desired closure target remains a separately attributed estimate.
Any unknown input makes the corresponding aggregate incomplete; show known subtotal plus missing categories instead of a complete total.
CashPosition: Each expected account has an AccountBalanceObservation or named coverage gap.

LaunchReadiness: acceptance_requirements_ref must identify the current independently admitted launch policy/requirements manifest selected from actual offer/service scope and mandates; the producer cannot choose easier criteria.

The manifest resolves every required requirement_id to an exact subject_ref and predicate_ref before readiness assembly, including relevant product/artifact, delivery capacity, support capacity and offer/readiness-condition subjects. The readiness record itself is not its own future evidence subject.

acceptance_bindings must contain exactly one binding for every required requirement_id, no duplicate IDs and no unapproved additions; each subject_ref and predicate_ref must equal the resolved manifest values.

Every binding.judgment_ref must resolve to current accepted EvidenceJudgment with matching exact subject/version and predicate/scope, current full evidence closure, authority and expiry. One judgment can be reused only when the required exact subject and predicate truly match.

A completed rejected/inconclusive/contested/stale judgment or an accepted report about missing evidence cannot meet a required child predicate. Any changed required child or mapping invalidates the composite readiness before release.

fulfillment_capacity and support_capacity must remain current verified DeliveryCapacity from pre-sale verification or a compatible accepted renewal. Distinct legitimate subjects require distinct matching judgments, not an impossible single Ref.
